data.narrative:
Transmutex is a Series A nuclear energy company that has raised $23M to date. The valuation analysis draws on a peer universe of 11 comparable companies—3 public (OKLO, NNE, SMR) and 8 private entities including Fuse Energy, Helion, Valar Atomics, X-Energy, and Oklo—spanning seed through Series B stages.

Two triangulation methods were applied. Stage-progression analysis, using the $23M raised as a valuation proxy and applying a 2.0x multiplier typical of Series A-to-next-stage advancement, implies $46M. Peer-median analysis across three same-sector, same/adjacent-stage comparables (Valar Atomics at $6.0B Series B, Nano Nuclear Energy at $808M Seed, and Fuse Energy at $200M Series A) yields a median valuation of $808M, with a range of $200M to $6.0B.

These methods triangulate to a low of $39M, median of $427M, and high of $929M. The stage-progression method anchors the lower bound, while peer comparables—particularly the $200M Fuse Energy Series A valuation—support the upper range. Key uncertainties include technology maturity relative to peers, path to commercialization, and the significant valuation dispersion within the nuclear energy sector ($200M to $6.0B across comparable rounds). Further diligence on technical differentiation and capital efficiency would refine the midpoint estimate.
